macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. jobs report boosts December Fed hike expectations
items.summary: U.S. employers added 165,000 jobs in October, well above expectations, while unemployment fell to 4.1%. The stronger labor market increased market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in December and pushed Treasury yields and the dollar higher.[1][7]

items.title: U.S. stocks rebound unevenly after sharp selloff
items.summary: The S&P 500 rose 0.3% and the Nasdaq gained 1.1% on Friday, while the Dow fell 0.5%. The recovery followed the S&P 500’s 4.4% Thursday decline, with chipmakers leading a rebound but broader concerns about AI valuations remaining.[1][5]

items.title: Semiconductor stocks lead market recovery
items.summary: AMD, SanDisk, Micron, Marvell, Intel and Nvidia rose sharply as investors bought beaten-down chip stocks. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index recovered more than 5% after plunging 12.2% in the previous session.[8]

items.title: Fed officials signal further tightening remains possible
items.summary: San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly said the central bank is prepared to raise rates further if necessary, while emphasizing that additional data are needed to determine the timing and extent of any tightening.[10]

items.title: AI investment concerns continue to pressure technology shares
items.summary: Investors remain concerned about high AI valuations, rising debt and uncertain returns on data-center spending. Microsoft is reportedly winding down a cloud-computing arrangement with Oracle, while Alphabet is taking over a Wyoming data-center project after an AI infrastructure startup failed to secure customers.[2][5]

items.title: Moderna returns to quarterly profit
items.summary: Moderna reported net income of $162 million in the third quarter, reversing a $200 million loss a year earlier. The result followed progress in its melanoma vaccine program.[7]

items.title: Tesla plans to discontinue Cybertruck production
items.summary: Tesla is reportedly winding down Cybertruck production by mid-2027 as it shifts manufacturing capacity toward its Cybercab autonomous vehicle program.[8]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Crypto market tumbles amid regulatory concerns
items.summary: Bitcoin fell about 3.2% to roughly $75,717 and Ether dropped 4.5% to about $2,238. Aggregate crypto liquidations rose to approximately $1.22 billion as investors reacted to U.S. regulatory uncertainty, a technology-stock selloff and a stronger dollar.

items.title: Nigeria tightens crypto rules and bans algorithmic stablecoins
items.summary: Nigeria announced a ban on algorithmic stablecoins and new reserve requirements for stablecoin issuers as part of a broader effort to strengthen oversight of crypto-payment services and financial stability.

items.title: China halts Solana-related event in Shanghai
items.summary: Chinese authorities stopped Solana advertising and offline communications activities in Shanghai, describing them as illegal virtual-currency-related financial activity and saying involved entities and individuals would be investigated.

items.title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter
items.summary: Standard Chartered’s SC Ventures and Japan’s SBI Group participated in a roughly $66 million Series B financing for Soter Insure, which provides insurance against crypto-asset losses and plans to expand underwriting capacity.

items.title: Zcash deploys NU7 network upgrade
items.summary: Zcash activated its NU7 upgrade, cutting the target block interval from 75 seconds to 25 seconds and changing fee allocation so that 60% goes to a new reserve and 40% to miners.

items.title: Bull Bitcoin adds default Payjoin support
items.summary: Bitcoin-focused exchange Bull Bitcoin integrated Payjoin for deposits and withdrawals by default, adding an on-chain privacy feature intended to make transaction flows harder to trace.

items.title: Hyperliquid burns more than 21,000 HYPE tokens
items.summary: Hyperliquid burned over 21,000 HYPE tokens valued at approximately $1.66 million during the past 24 hours, according to on-chain monitoring data.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: AI-assisted research reportedly helps prove quantum-computing conjecture
items.summary: Physical Superintelligence said a research system using an unreleased Anthropic model helped prove the Aaronson–Ambainis conjecture in three days. The claim has not yet been independently verified in the available coverage.

items.title: Google DeepMind reports AI-assisted attacks on legacy RSA-1024
items.summary: Google DeepMind reportedly said human-guided AI agents identified two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA and achieved substantially lower costs for some batch attacks. The report emphasized that modern RSA-2048 and larger keys remain secure.

items.title: OpenAI and Ligo launch wet-lab AI benchmark
items.summary: OpenAI and biotechnology company Ligo released BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark evaluating AI agents on routine laboratory work involving images, sequencing data, microscopy, and videos. The reported results showed GPT-6 Astra outperforming GPT-5.6 Sol on the benchmark.

items.title: Google makes Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available
items.summary: Google reportedly made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available through the Gemini API and business and Google Cloud offerings, expanding access to a lightweight multimodal model.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for approved customers
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly launched GPT-6 Cyber as a restricted-access model focused on cybersecurity, claiming stronger vulnerability-finding performance than GPT-6 Astra and improved safeguards against misuse.

items.title: Moonshot AI publishes Kimi K3.1 Pro weights
items.summary: Moonshot AI reportedly released the full weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro on Hugging Face. The model was described as the highest-ranked open-weight model on the cited BenchLM leaderboard, though the ranking is not independently verified here.

items.title: Anthropic begins rolling out Claude Personal Finance
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly started offering a read-only personal-finance feature to U.S. paid users through Plaid, with claims that connected financial data would not be used for model training.

items.title: AI concerns contribute to global stock-market volatility
items.summary: Reports linked a worldwide sell-off in technology and AI-related stocks to investor concerns about the scale and returns of AI investment, as well as possible future regulation.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: PIF and Silver Lake reportedly explore $25 billion Unity acquisition
items.summary: Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund and Silver Lake Partners have reportedly discussed acquiring Unity Software at a valuation of roughly $25 billion. No agreement has been reached, and Unity is evaluating its options with an investment bank.[8]

items.title: EA releases 25 classic PC games on Steam
items.summary: Electronic Arts released 25 classic PC titles, including the Ultima and Wing Commander series. Seven games received Anniversary Edition restorations featuring technical improvements and recovered video footage.[9]

items.title: GOG announces Linux launcher and preservation initiatives
items.summary: GOG’s first showcase announced that GOG Galaxy is in development for Linux, revealed restored Wing Commander Anniversary Editions, and introduced the Retrovibe publishing label and a beta social feature.[6]

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day to add legacy content in Season 2
items.summary: The Coalition’s upcoming Season 2 content will bring back classic maps, modes, and skins, following the recent return of the Guardian mode. Players can also claim a free General RAAM multiplayer skin.[2]

items.title: Microsoft reveals Xbox Game Pass November Wave 1 lineup
items.summary: Microsoft announced 13 titles for the first November 2026 Xbox Game Pass wave, led by Football Manager 27, with releases spanning Xbox, PC, and cloud gaming.[1]

items.title: Escape Academy 2 launches with Xbox Game Pass availability
items.summary: Coin Crew Games and iam8bit released Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School worldwide, with the puzzle game joining Xbox Game Pass on day one.[1]
